{{Quote|Yes, yes, I am ''Pitor'', the foreman for the plant! ''Pitor'', as in ''Pitor Processing Plantworks''! All the P's, you see? ''Aha''!|Pitor to [[clone trooper]] Coric|<ref name="A Small Scrappy War!">{{TCWComicCite|6.33|A Small Scrappy War!}}</ref>}}
[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] '''Pitor''' was the [[Biituian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] owner of [[Pitor Processing Plantworks]], a salvage company on [[Biitu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

When [[Clone trooper]]s [[Rex]] and [[Coric]] landed on his planet, Biitu, he welcomed them very heartwarmingly and they helped him to get rid of the [[Reanimator]], a decommissioned [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] droid who went berserk and started repairing and "reviving" damaged [[B1-series battle droid]]s dropped on the planet as a junk scrap.
